# Prediction intervals on test (generated by scripts/conformal_intervals.py)

Rules fixed in `results/conformal/PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `8874076`) before scoring. Split conformal calibrated on the validation windows, per forecast step. `abs` = ŷ ± q (price units); `rel` = ŷ ± q·P_t (q from |e|/P_t). Coverage pooled over all (window, step) pairs; mean ± std over seeds. Verdict: within ±5 pp of nominal = close; else under/over-covers. Width ratio = mean width / persistence's width under the same score and level.
